metadata.name: Blosm simple 3D building volumes
metadata.description: Initial footprint-agnostic import template: apartments, house and office policies, a generic fallback, and flat/skillion/gabled/hipped volumes.
notes: Evaluate independently in one externally supplied footprint context at a time, using a client-supplied global random seed, metres and Z up.
Blosm initially normalizes OSM tags, terrain-relative elevations and input-presence flags. The flags then describe current supplied inputs, including user edits. All elevation offsets use T_min.

Wall-level models use footprint-scoped top_height at levels.wall.top_height. If absent from the footprint, sample uniformly from 0.3 to 1 m once per footprint. It is part of the wall range and participates in wall fitting; it is not applicable in branches without a level model.

Reevaluate branch conditions after edits. Specifying a wall-level count sets levels_wall_count and has_levels_wall_count=true together; an originally absent count can therefore select a different branch. Derived outputs do not set presence flags.

Keep current supplied inputs and allocated results separate. Retain stable footprint identities and unchanged random samples, refresh dependent formulas after edits, and fit from declared preferences rather than previously fitted heights. No original imported value/flag history is required.

The planned Keep max_elevation fixed GUI control maps to has_max_elevation. The user judges the fitted floor heights and chooses whether to release the constraint. Blosm does not introduce architectural fit-acceptability thresholds or release it automatically; mathematical and geometric validation still applies.

The first Blosm compiler requires min_elevation <= base_elevation + wall_min_height after height resolution. It constructs the enclosure from min_elevation; cases requiring roof trimming are deferred. This implementation limit does not change PADL language semantics.
Random distributions are provisional editable design defaults, not measured building statistics.
No operation-reference extension is used. Pitched roof.type resolves per footprint to skillion, gabled or hipped; the backend selects the corresponding reusable generator.
The input contract, initialization policy, interactive editing and limitations are documented in buildings/README.md.
